lines.en: My neck brushes the treetops.

lines.zh: 四条长腿一步跨一条沟。
lines.en: Four long legs cross a ditch in one stride.
Trees bend as I pass.

lines.zh: 蹄子落地，土被压出一个坑。
lines.en: My hooves press pits into the soil.

lines.zh: 我高得能看见远处的烟。
lines.en: I am tall enough to see smoke far off.

lines.zh: 我慢慢迈步，地面跟着闷响。
lines.en: I walk slowly and the ground answers.

lines.zh: 脖子在枝叶间划开一条缝。
lines.en: My neck parts a gap through the leaves.
I reach across above the canopy.
My shadow covers half the meadow.
I duck under a low branch.

lines.zh: 风从我的脊背上一路滑下。
lines.en: Wind slides all the way down my spine.

lines.zh: 这条腿落地时，石头碎了。
lines.en: A stone splits when this leg lands.
I stand with my head under the clouds.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼着够到的叶子。
lines.en: I slowly chew leaves within reach.

lines.zh: 脖子一动，整片树都在晃。
lines.en: One move of my neck shakes the whole tree.

lines.zh: 我不需要低头也能看世界。
lines.en: I need not bow to see the world.

lines.zh: 身上斑纹在光里一块块变。
lines.en: My patches shift one by one in the light.
I stand like a tower of wood.

lines.zh: 远处有只兔子盯着我看。
lines.en: A rabbit far off is staring at me.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸把叶子吹得发抖。
lines.en: My breath makes the leaves shiver.

lines.zh: 很久没有东西敢靠近了。
lines.en: Nothing has dared come near for a while.

lines.zh: 我在听地面传来的震动。
lines.en: I listen to tremors through the ground.

lines.zh: 树影落在我背上的斑纹里。
lines.en: Tree shade falls among my patches.
I tilt my head a little; the clouds move.
My tail sweeps the brush.

lines.zh: 你连我的膝盖都够不到。
lines.en: You cannot even reach my knees.
I lower my head to see you clearly.
You stand in my shadow, very small.
Look up too long and you will get dizzy.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在很高的地方。
lines.en: My eyes are very high up.
You mean to cut my legs? Try it.
Your sweat fills my nostrils.
I bend my neck into an arch.
Step back; I need not chase.

lines.zh: 我认出你了，矮小的东西。
lines.en: I know you now, little thing.
What you hold looks like a blade of grass.
I consider you from above.

lines.zh: 你说话的声音传不到我耳朵。
lines.en: Your voice barely reaches my ears.
If you run, one stride will do.

lines.zh: 我的影子比你的房子还宽。
lines.en: My shadow is wider than your house.

lines.zh: 别站那么近，我会踩到你。
lines.en: Don't stand so close; I will step on you.
I see your grip tighten.
Good; at last you look up.
You struck one long leg; it stings.

lines.zh: 我的皮很厚，也不至于没感觉。
lines.en: My hide is thick, not numb.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，树上的鸟都飞了。
lines.en: I bellow and the birds flee the trees.
Blood runs down between my patches.
You cut deep; I will remember.
I bend my neck and look at the wound.
However it hurts, my legs will not buckle.

lines.zh: 好，你现在真的惹到我了。
lines.en: Now you have truly angered me.
Young acacia leaves are my favorite.
I lower my head for the leaves.
That tuft at the treetop is just in reach.

lines.zh: 你把叶子举高些，再高些。
lines.en: Hold the leaves higher, higher still.
Sweetness drifts up my nose on the wind.
This height is no trouble for me.
Don't sway the branch; I cannot aim.

lines.zh: 吃一口，我就多待一会儿。
lines.en: One mouthful and I will linger.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪了半步，你就飞了。
lines.en: I shift half a step and you are thrown.

lines.zh: 这一碰，你的骨头响了一声。
lines.en: The bump makes something in you crack.
My legs are hard as oak.
My shadow knocks you over.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，土从蹄下蹦出。
lines.en: We collide and dirt sprays from my hooves.
Don't press into the bend of my knee.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你还没起来。
lines.en: I lower my head; you have not risen.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，只是我太大。
lines.en: That was not heavy; I am simply large.

lines.zh: 你退了三步，我一步没动。
lines.en: You take three steps; I take none.

lines.zh: 这身变异骨架，配不成对。
lines.en: This mutated frame will not pair.

lines.zh: 我的脖子太长，交颈都难。
lines.en: My neck is too long for an embrace.
I only want taller trees.
You asked the wrong creature, little one.
I look down at you, then turn away.
A grazing beast does not speak of this.

lines.zh: 我在等另一头一样高的影子。
lines.en: I wait for another shadow as tall as mine.

lines.zh: 这地方没有配得上我的。
lines.en: Nothing here is my equal.
I snort out a breath and walk off.
My mind is up in the canopy.
I bend my long neck to take it.

lines.zh: 这东西在我蹄边像粒沙。
lines.en: It looks like a grain of sand by my hoof.
I curl it up with my lips.
Too high; I nearly bit empty air.
I lift my head with it in my mouth.
Too small for me, but I keep it.

lines.zh: 我把它放在蹄边的石上。
lines.en: I set it on a stone by my hoof.

lines.zh: 脖子弯下来时，影子也弯了。
lines.en: As my neck bends, so does my shadow.
One bite and it is in two.
There; hold it steady, don't drop it again.
I lower my head and fix on you.

lines.zh: 我的影子停在你身上了。
lines.en: My shadow has stopped on you.
You, the small thing, are the one.
My neck turns toward you, slowly.
Run; I want to see.

lines.zh: 你今天不该走这条林道。
lines.en: You picked the wrong forest path today.
I tense both forelegs.

lines.zh: 风把你身上的味道送上来。
lines.en: The wind carries your scent up to me.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，悬着不动。
lines.en: I raise one leg and hold it still.
You are within two of my strides.

lines.zh: 猎物抬头看了一眼，很好。
lines.en: The prey glances up; good.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经压住你的退路。
lines.en: My shadow already covers your retreat.
Not grass this time.
When I lower my head, the trees go quiet.

lines.zh: 我一步跨出三米，跟着你。
lines.en: Each stride eats three meters.

lines.zh: 你往林子里钻，可树太矮。
lines.en: You dive into the wood, but the trees are short.

lines.zh: 我抬起脖子，越过树冠看你。
lines.en: I lift my neck and watch you over the canopy.

lines.zh: 你在河对岸，我直接趟过去。
lines.en: You are across the river; I wade through.
I do not run; walking is enough.
Your tracks are too shallow to bother with.

lines.zh: 你拐了弯，我的头也转过去。
lines.en: You turn a corner; my head follows.
The ground thunders; that is me.
You pant behind a tree; I stop.
You slow down, and I see it plainly.
Down, around, up again.

lines.zh: 我不需要快，我只需要高。
lines.en: I need no speed, only height.

lines.zh: 这条路尽头是悬崖，对吧。
lines.en: This path ends at a cliff, doesn't it.
I snap the branches one by one.
Your heartbeat carries far.
Ten more steps and you have no road.
I smell you, and I smell your fear.
My forehooves come down and the earth splits.

lines.zh: 我甩头，脖子扫过一片树。
lines.en: I swing my head and my neck clears a swath of trees.

lines.zh: 一脚踢出，你撞上了树干。
lines.en: One kick sends you into a trunk.

lines.zh: 这一下带着我整个身子的重量。
lines.en: The blow carries my whole weight.
You block, and your shield is already warped.
I lower my head and toss you up.
I do not punch; I use legs.
Where my hoof lands, the turf peels.
Before you steady, I lift a leg again.

lines.zh: 这一脚踏得你趴在地上。
lines.en: This stomp puts you flat.
Blood in the mud; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，重新调整角度。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and line up again.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴抽过来，你没看见。
lines.en: My tail whips around unseen.
You dodge; I only kick dirt.
One more and you will not move.
I raise a foreleg again, unhurried.
My head comes through the leaves first.

lines.zh: 我站起来，比你看见的树都高。
lines.en: I rise taller than any tree in sight.
Dry leaves crush under my hooves.
I step out into the clearing.
My neck unfolds and the sky comes closer.

lines.zh: 这地方太矮，我喘不过气。
lines.en: This place is too low; I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 我摇晃着站定，斑纹在抖。
lines.en: I sway, settle, my patches trembling.
Small beasts flee in the distance.
I smell water, and iron.

lines.zh: 第一次走出这么高的地方。
lines.en: First time I have walked this high.
I coil my neck past a low branch.

lines.zh: 风顶着我，我却站得更稳。
lines.en: The wind pushes me; I stand firmer.

lines.zh: 我的影子拉长到林子尽头。
lines.en: My shadow stretches to the wood's edge.
Something new is moving; it is short.

lines.zh: 我踩碎一块石头，声音很闷。
lines.en: I crush a stone and the sound is dull.
I lift my eyes and see a torch.

lines.zh: 这具身体太大了，可我喜欢。
lines.en: This body is too big, and I like it.
Very well; first, some tall grass.

lines.zh: 火沿着我的长腿往上爬。
lines.en: Fire climbs my long legs.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下，腿折了一下。
lines.en: I crash from a height and a leg folds.

lines.zh: 水没到我的胸口，我抬着头喘。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest; I keep my head up and gasp.
The blast rocks me; I do not fall.
An arrow sticks in my neck.

lines.zh: 那股力量从蹄底窜上来。
lines.en: That force shoots up from my hooves.

lines.zh: 没有高处的叶子，我饿得发晕。
lines.en: No high leaves; hunger makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的长脖子走了一遭。
lines.en: Lightning runs the length of my neck.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我的长腿乱蹬。
lines.en: The ground is gone; my long legs kick at nothing.
